subject: VPC commercial structure — composite discounts, platform fee amortization, and SLA windows
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medisyshealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: susan.li@medisyshealth.com, procurement@medisyshealth.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial questions on VPC pricing + platform fee amortization

Neha / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and engineering dug into the draft SOW and we have a couple of commercial items we need clarified before our CFO greenlights the commit:

1) Composite discounting: our procurement team wants a single blended discount applied across committed GPU-hours, platform fee, and the onboarding retainer. Is that something Redwood can provide, or do you itemize discounts per SKU?

2) Platform fee amortization: we prefer amortizing the platform fee over 24 months in the deal economics. Can you share an example amortization schedule and confirm whether the fee can be capitalized for our finance team?

3) SLA windows & credits: we need clearer language around regional SLA windows (US-East vs US-West) and how credits are calculated if you fail a monthly latency or availability SLO.

4) Support tiers: we are leaning to an enterprise support retainer but would like an option to scale down after year 1 if utilization is below forecast. Any flexibility there?

Attaching the SOW v2 we returned with inline comments — can you point me to the digestible commercial options (a short table or matrix)? We aim to present to our CFO next Tuesday.

Appreciate a quick read — if easier, happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Cloud Infrastructure, Medisys Health
Attachments: Medisys_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial questions on VPC pricing + platform fee amortization

Tom —

Thanks for the clear set of asks. Short answers up front, then a proposed matrix attached.

- Composite discounting: we can offer a blended discount on the commercial package (compute + platform fee + onboarding) for committed multi-year deals. We typically quote either blended or line-item discounts depending on procurement preference — both are acceptable.

- Platform fee amortization: yes, we can provide an amortization schedule. We commonly offer 12 or 24 month amortization schedules; capital treatment will depend on your accounting policy, but we can supply the schedule and the invoice cadence to support your finance team. See attached platform-fee-amortization.xlsx.

- SLA windows & credits: we can tier SLAs by region (US-East/US-West) and provide monthly service credits calculated as percentage of monthly fees for missed SLOs. Sample language included in the attached price matrix.

- Support tiers: we offer an enterprise retainer with a 12-month minimum and a flexible scale-down clause after month 12 with a 90-day notice. For longer commitments (24–36 months) we can offer a step-down credit in year 2.

Two commercial options attached for your review:

Option 1 — Predictable Commit (recommended for steady production workloads)
- 36 month commit on nodes (GPU-hours)
- Blended discount across compute + platform fee = 12%
- Platform fee amortized over 24 months on invoice schedule
- Enterprise support (priority 24x7) included; onboarding retainer credited against month 1–3 invoices

Option 2 — Flex Commit
- 12–24 month commit with higher per-unit pricing but lower upfront; blended discount = 6%
- Platform fee invoiced up front or amortized depending on your preference
- Support offered as monthly retainer with scaling option after month 12

We attached a redwood_vpc_price_matrix.csv that lays out per-GPU pricing at different commit tiers and the blended economics. If you want, we can run your numbers against your forecast and return a tailored amortization schedule.

If these high-level options look workable, Marissa and Karthik will prepare a negotiable term sheet we can share with Procurement.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: platform-fee-amortization.xlsx (XLSX), redwood_vpc_price_matrix.csv (CSV)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial questions on VPC pricing + platform fee amortization (internal notes)

Internal — quick notes / recommended concessions before we send a term sheet to Medisys:

1) Discounting approach: give blended discount as requested but protect marginal economics by locking compute floor pricing. Proposal: 12% blended at 36-month commit, but compute units floor at 85% of list rate. This lets us honor the blended discount while preventing under-recovery on burst hours.

2) Platform fee amortization: we can amortize over 24 months and provide monthly invoices hitting the client's CAPEX request. Finance prefers amortization to be recorded as a separate line on the invoice for auditability.

3) SLA windows: offer 99.9% availability across both regions; for latency SLOs, allow two-hour maintenance windows per week for scheduled ops (must be pre-notified). Credits: simple tiered credit schedule (0.5% for minor, 2% for major monthly misses) capped at 10% monthly.

4) Support retainer: propose $120k/year retainer for Priority Enterprise with 24x7 oncall, optional year-2 reduction to $80k with 90-day notice if usage < 60% of forecast. Include one-time onboarding credit of $75k if they sign the 36-month commit within 30 days.

5) Approval ask: I need sign-off on the $75k onboarding credit and the compute-floor concession. Ben / Karthik — can you confirm these are within deal authority? If not, I will escalate to sales leadership.

I'll draft a clean term sheet once we lock these items.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medisyshealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@medisyshealth.com>, susan.li@medisyshealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial questions on VPC pricing + platform fee amortization — proposed terms

Tom / Susan / Procurement team —

Following internal alignment, below is the concise commercial proposal we recommend for Medisys. This mirrors what we discussed on the call and is intended to simplify procurement review:

Summary of proposed terms (high-level)
- Commit: 36 months, committed GPU-hours as per forecast attached to the SOW
- Composite discount: 12% blended across compute + platform fee + onboarding retainer
- Platform fee amortization: 24 months (we will provide an amortization schedule and separate invoice lines to support capitalization)
- SLA: 99.9% regional availability (US-East/US-West). Credits: 0.5% (minor monthly miss), 2% (major monthly miss), capped at 10% of monthly fees. Two-hour weekly maintenance window allowed with prior notice.
- Support: Priority Enterprise retainer at $120,000/year with an option to step down to $80,000/year after month 12 with 90-day notice if utilization < 60% of forecast.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $75,000 credit applied to first invoice if signed within 30 days.

Attachments: platform-fee-amortization.xlsx (contains a 24-month schedule), redwood_vpc_price_matrix.csv (pricing at commit tiers). Also attaching a link to the draft term sheet in HubSpot for procurement redlines: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Next steps
1) Procurement to confirm whether amortized platform fee is acceptable to your accounting team (we can provide sample invoice lines).
2) If these terms look good, we'll circulate a short term sheet for legal redline and route to DocuSign.
3) Once signed, onboarding and a technical kickoff are scheduled — Marissa will own delivery and Karthik will coordinate capacity planning.

If you'd like a quick call to walk through the amortization spreadsheet, we can run through your forecast and show the monthly P&L impact.

Looking forward —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: platform-fee-amortization.xlsx, redwood_vpc_price_matrix.csv, Medisys_SOW_v2.pdf (annotated)
